facts.text: Banyan Tree Doha is a 5-star hotel located in the heart of Mushaireb in Doha.
facts.excerpt: Located in the heart of Mushaireb, Banyan Tree Doha is a premier 5-star hotel

facts.text: The hotel is located between West Bay and the Old City, close to Souq Waqif, the Corniche, the National Museum of Qatar, the Museum of Islamic Art and the Msheireb Museums.
facts.excerpt: We are strategically located between West Bay and the Old City, with proximity to Souq Waqif, Corniche, Qatar National Museum, Museum of Islamic Art and Musheireb Museums.

facts.text: Set within Doha Oasis, the hotel has direct access to the indoor theme park Quest and the Printemps Doha department store.
facts.excerpt: Nestled within Doha Oasis, we provide direct access to the indoor theme park Quest and the largest luxury department store in the Middle East, Printemps Doha

facts.text: The hotel offers easy access to the Doha Metro.
facts.excerpt: offers guests easy access to key commercial and residential areas as well as the Doha Metro

facts.text: The hotel is a 20-minute drive from Hamad International Airport.
facts.excerpt: a 20-minute drive from the Hamad International Airport

facts.text: Guests have free access to West Bay Beach, a 10-minute drive from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Guests can enjoy free access to West Bay Beach which is only 10-min drive from the hotel.

facts.text: The property's design combines traditional Asian principles with Arabian heritage.
facts.excerpt: Every detail of the property represents a harmony of traditional Asian principles and rich Arabian heritage

facts.text: Rooms and suites blend contemporary luxury design with Arabic influences.
facts.excerpt: Our elegant hotel rooms and suites seamlessly blend contemporary luxury design with distinct Arabic influences.

facts.text: Rooms and suites have floor-to-ceiling glass windows with views of Doha.
facts.excerpt: Admire clear, unobstructed views of Doha through expansive floor-to-ceiling glass windows.

facts.text: Rooms and suites offer views of the Arabian Gulf, gardens and Doha's historic old city.
facts.excerpt: each offering breathtaking views of the Arabian Gulf, verdant gardens, and Doha's historical old city

facts.text: Bathrooms each have a separate bathtub and walk-in shower.
facts.excerpt: elegant bathrooms, each with its own separate bathtub and walk-in shower

facts.text: Each room has a kettle and a Nespresso coffee machine.
facts.excerpt: each room is equipped with a kettle and a Nespresso coffee machine

facts.text: The Harmony Sky Suite has panoramic views of Doha, a separate dining room, a living area, a bedroom with a walk-in closet and a bathroom with views.
facts.excerpt: This expansive suite features a separate dining room, a spacious living area, a grand bedroom with a walk-in closet, and a bathroom offering breathtaking views.

facts.text: Harmony Sky Suite guests receive club benefits.
facts.excerpt: Guests enjoy exclusive club benefits

facts.text: The Bliss Signature Suite has panoramic views of the bay or the oasis.
facts.excerpt: calming interiors meet panoramic views of the bay or the oasis beyond

facts.text: Rooms and suites do not have balconies, while all the residences do.
facts.excerpt: We don’t have balconies in the rooms and Suites. However, all our residences have balconies.

facts.text: Banyan Tree Spa Doha's treatments are inspired by Asian traditions and enhanced with modern wellness practices.
facts.excerpt: Inspired by Asian traditions and enhanced with modern wellness practices, our signature treatments

facts.text: The spa has separate male and female areas with treatment rooms, heated beds, a vitality pool with a Jacuzzi, relaxation areas, a brine steam room, a herbal sauna and a rain walk.
facts.excerpt: The spa features exclusive male and female spaces equipped with treatment rooms, heated beds, a vitality pool complete with a Jacuzzi, relaxation areas, a brine steam room, a herbal sauna and a rain walk.

facts.text: The spa combines its signature treatments with hydrothermal facilities in The Rainforest.
facts.excerpt: combining the best of its signature spa treatments with its state-of-the-art hydrothermal facilities within The Rainforest

facts.text: The hotel has an outdoor pool and an indoor pool with a jet spa.
facts.excerpt: Swim beneath the sun in our outdoor pool or relax in our indoor pool and jet spa after a long day out.

facts.text: The hotel has an executive lounge.
facts.excerpt: including an award-winning spa and an executive lounge

facts.text: The hotel has a fully equipped fitness centre and a Kids Club.
facts.excerpt: family-friendly facilities and amenities, such as a fully-equipped fitness centre and a Kids Club

facts.text: The hotel's restaurants serve modern Thai, Italian and Indian cuisine.
facts.excerpt: From modern Thai cuisine to unique Italian and Indian creations

facts.text: Vertigo is a club on level 28 with 360-degree views of Doha.
facts.excerpt: Located on level 28, Vertigo Doha is one of the highest clubs in the Mushaireb area with incredible 360-degree views of Doha

facts.text: The concierge team can help book popular activities in Doha such as city tours and desert safaris.
facts.excerpt: our concierge team is available to assist you in curating and booking the most popular touristic activities in Doha

facts.text: Banyan Tree Doha Residences are adjacent to and connected with the hotel tower.
facts.excerpt: Banyan Tree Doha Residences are located adjacent and conveniently connected to the hotel tower
